answer: To forge a thousand fake identities, an attacker must expend a thousand times the energy, freezing capital like a glacier—slow, costly, and visible on-chain before any stake is granted. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work identity anchoring: each agent must solve a per-epoch cipher puzzle whose difficulty scales with network size, binding identity to burned compute. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
